samples.identity: Snake Kaka with Plankton remote JAR loader
evidence: Snake starts AndroidMDKService; loader posts device identity and permissions, accepts server-supplied URL/fileName, downloads a JAR into the private plakntond directory and loads AndroidMDKProvider via DexClassLoader.
The loader implements background retry and reflective provider initialization, with a persistent upgrade preference.
Added a bounded family identity using the provider literal, actual private-cache argument and class-loader constructor call.
limitations: The remote second-stage JAR is not embedded and was not fetched. Unseen remote commands are not attributed to this artifact.
One independently supported hostile family finding; bad-pool move held by the skill coverage prerequisite.

evidence: Reviewed 74 DEX members, first-party tournament/account/wallet/payment flows and FCM notification handling.
Statically recovered 1719 strings from Base64 plus repeating UTF-8 XOR; decoded code implements account registration, match entry, payments and notifications.
The FirebaseMessagingService name is a normal notification-service reference, not a C2 channel.
One decoded embedded private PEM key parses successfully; the encoded private-key header now has a neutral finding. This is exposed key material and does not establish malicious intent.
limitations: Other decoded PEM-like strings did not parse as complete private keys. The detector reports the encoded header, not a validated live credential.
